Have a question?

Quick answers before you book. Still unsure? Ask us in the form below.

What happens in a first consultation?

We start with your birth details and the question you want answered. You leave with clear next steps, not a list of predictions.

Do you work online?

Yes. Consultations are available online and offline, for clients in India and worldwide.

What is the 3 months of handholding?

After the consultation we stay in touch for three months, to check that the remedies are working and to adjust them as things change.

Do I need my exact birth time?

It helps for a birth chart reading. If you do not have it, say so, and we will tell you what can still be read.

Do I need to break walls for Vastu?

No. Most Vastu corrections need no construction at all. We start with simple changes such as moving furniture, adjusting colours, and placing remedies in the right zones. Structural changes come up only when something is seriously out of balance, and we will tell you plainly if that is the case.

Is my consultation confidential?

Yes. Your birth details, questions and everything we discuss stay private. We do not share them with anyone.
